name: Reactoonz

features.name: Quantum Leap meter
features.description: Winning symbols charge a meter that triggers random grid modifiers.

features.name: Gargantoon
features.description: A fully charged meter releases a giant wild that splits into smaller wilds.

review:
No traditional free spins here. Instead, every winning cluster charges a Quantum meter, and filling it unleashes features – ending with the Gargantoon, a giant alien that's still one of the most fun moments in any cluster slot.

That design keeps the base game busy and constantly building towards something. Years after release, it's still one of Play'n GO's best games. High volatility, 4,570x max, 96.51% RTP.
pros: No-free-spins design that still feels rewarding
